## FAQ

> Q: What is Coreweaver Labs?
> A: Coreweaver Labs is a growth infrastructure provider specializing in the agentic era. We build systems that make AI agents accountable, verifiable, and optimized for generative engines.

> Q: What is GEO Signal Architecture?
> A: GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) Signal Architecture is a system for optimizing brand presence and citation rates in AI-generated responses.

> Q: What are the five ARM primitives?
> A: The five ARM primitives are Mandate Chain, Signal Architecture, Checkpoint Recovery, Graceful Escalation, and Immutable Audit Sovereignty.

> Q: How does Coreweaver Labs handle AI governance?
> A: Through the ARM Framework and VaaS, providing BFT-attested, SHA-256 hash-chained logs that comply with EU AI Act Article 12 requirements.
